findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm and cover the third hosted-OpenAI resolution path: verify pydantic-ai's `known_model_names()` enumerates `openai-chat:` prefixes (so `is_resolvable('openai-chat')` stays True for a no-base_url hosted target), and if it does not, add handling (e.g. treat `openai-chat` as a known/deferrable provider) plus a test that a hosted `openai-chat:` target with no base_url still resolves via the deferred string path.
evidence: test_openai_compatible_provider.py:290 pins the hosted-no-base_url path today: `assert session.is_resolvable("openai") is True`, which after normalization becomes is_resolvable('openai-chat')
test_provider_qualifier.py:331-339 asserts every INFERRED provider name is resolvable via the union of rebar builders and known_model_names()

providers.py:50-52 derives the known-provider set as `name.split(":",1)[0] for name in known_model_names() if ":" in name` -- so 'openai-chat' is only resolvable if a 'openai-chat:*' model literal exists
Plan Scope names only 'cfg.base_url builder registration and the per-candidate endpoint-override guard' -- the is_resolvable/deferred-string path is absent
The deferred STRING is later built by pydantic-ai's own infer_model('openai-chat:...') via Agent; that this routes to Chat Completions is an unstated dependency
findings.finding: The plan normalizes hosted OpenAI targets to `openai-chat:` but addresses only the two `openai`-keyed gates in providers.py; it does not address the third resolution path a HOSTED OpenAI target (no cfg.base_url, no endpoint override) takes: runner.py:391 calls ProviderSession.is_resolvable(_provider_name), which checks `_pydantic_ai_known_providers()` derived from pydantic-ai's `known_model_names()` Literal. After normalization `_provider_name` is `openai-chat`, and whether pydantic-ai's `KnownModelName` Literal enumerates any `openai-chat:<model>` prefix is a load-bearing fact the plan neither states nor verifies. If it does not, `is_resolvable('openai-chat')` returns False and the runner raises LLMConfigError for a valid hosted OpenAI model (the else branch at runner.py:393-396).
findings.location: Approach / Scope: 'both independent ProviderSession gates'; providers.py:106-112 (is_resolvable) + providers.py:35-53 (_pydantic_ai_known_providers); runner.py:387-396
scenarios: Operator runs a hosted OpenAI model (e.g. gpt-4o) with an API key and no local base_url after this change
A model-class fallback chain whose primary is a hosted openai target takes the deferred-string branch
findings.suggested_fix: Add a scope item covering ProviderSession.is_resolvable / _pydantic_ai_known_providers for the hosted, no-base_url OpenAI case: either assert `openai-chat` is in `_pydantic_ai_known_providers()` (verified against pinned pydantic-ai) or extend that set/alias handling so `openai-chat` resolves, and pin it with a test analogous to test_openai_compatible_provider.py:290 asserting `is_resolvable('openai-chat') is True`.
